name: veh-apc-unarmed
note: L8-L9 unarmed APC transport (veh.military-apc decay variant 'unarmed', left) beside the armed set piece (right), game-camera turntable. Look for: no turret/gun/shield/muzzle on the transport, closed roof hatch (no hole), same hull/wheels/livery, six wheels grounded, antenna present, no floating or sunk parts and no LOD pops while the camera orbits.
